title: Uniform
subtitle: Uniform = a standard set of clothes worn by members of the same school, organisation, occu
description: Uniform = a standard set of clothes worn by members of the same school, organisation, occupation, service, or group. 替換時要分清 standardised clothing, practical work clothes, regulation dress, officially issued clothing, occupational workwear, traditional livery, 和 prescribed attire。

words.example: All front-of-house staff wear standard clothing supplied by the company.
words.exampleZh: 所有前台員工都穿公司提供的統一服裝。

exercises.original: The company introduced a new uniform for all reception staff.
exercises.zh: 公司為所有接待員工推出新的統一服裝。
exercises.upgrade: A. Standard clothing · 標準服裝；統一服裝

options.explanation: Standard clothing ✓ — clothing of an agreed or standard design worn by members of the same group。本句關鍵是 same standard design across staff is central；因此 Standard clothing 最精準。
Work clothes — clothes worn for work, especially practical clothing suited to a job。work clothes 只是工作時穿的衣服，未必統一款式或由機構規定；校服、軍服等不宜一般化。
Prescribed attire — clothing that people are formally required to wear。prescribed attire 強調規定衣着，但不一定所有人穿完全相同款式；若題目重點是 standard design / issued kit，會不夠精準。
Dress code — rules about what people should wear。dress code 是規則，不是那套衣服本身。
Costume — clothing worn for a performance, role, or special occasion。costume 多用於表演、角色扮演或特殊裝扮，不等於制服。
Outfit — a set of clothes worn together。outfit 只是一次穿着的一套衣服，不帶統一或規定意味。

Outfit — a set of clothes worn together。outfit 只是一次穿着的一套衣服，不帶統一或規定意味。

exercises.original: The role requires a uniform during official public events.
exercises.zh: 這個職位在正式公開活動中要求穿指定服裝。
exercises.upgrade: C. Prescribed attire · 指定服裝；規定衣着

options.explanation: Regulation dress — clothing required by official rules or regulations。regulation dress 偏正式規章／制服團體；一般公司工作服或酒店服務制服可能太正式。
Standard clothing — clothing of an agreed or standard design worn by members of the same group。standard clothing 是廣義解釋性替代；若有規章、正式配發、傳統服務形象等線索，另有更精準詞。
Prescribed attire ✓ — clothing that people are formally required to wear。本句關鍵是 formal clothing requirement is the focus；因此 Prescribed attire 最精準。
Dress code — rules about what people should wear。dress code 是規則，不是那套衣服本身。
Costume — clothing worn for a performance, role, or special occasion。costume 多用於表演、角色扮演或特殊裝扮，不等於制服。
Outfit — a set of clothes worn together。outfit 只是一次穿着的一套衣服，不帶統一或規定意味。

falseSynonyms.zh: 服裝規定 ≠ uniform dress code 是規則，不是那套衣服本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Dress code is a rule, not the clothing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 戲服／裝扮 ≠ uniform costume 多用於表演、角色或特殊裝扮。
一套衣服 ≠ uniform outfit 只是某次穿着的一套衣服，不必統一或規定。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Outfit is a general clothing set.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只在職業／實用工作服 sense 接近 workwear 不要求所有員工穿完全相同款式。
只在傳統／服務識別制服 sense 接近 livery 語域更傳統、更窄。
防護衣 ≠ uniform 防護衣重點是安全功能，不一定是制服。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Protective clothing is safety-focused.

falseSynonyms.zh: 正裝 ≠ uniform formal wear 是正式服飾類型，不等於指定制服。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Formal wear is occasion-focused.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 uniform 可作名詞／形容詞；uniformly 是副詞。
